sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one description
sections.content: A full description of a person chains what you already know: appearance (haj, -s "having X"), personality words, hasonló/különböző, olyan... mint, and aki clauses — all from this unit.

items.spanish: Petra a kolléganőm, aki nagyon szorgalmas és barátságos.
items.english: Petra is my colleague, who is very hardworking and friendly.

items.spanish: Tamás a szomszédom, aki szakállas és nagyon türelmes.
items.english: Tamás is my neighbor, who is bearded and very patient.

sections.content: kolléganő ("female colleague") is built the same way barátnő is — kolléga plus nő. You already own that pattern from A1.
